analysis.common_term_scope: Current physical/cleanup terms with F,V,controls,NN and gates fixed; constant kinetic/control/constitutive costs included in values
analysis.sensitivity_scope: Gradient dot observed endpoint displacement; negative locally rewards this direction; not energy/work, feasible motion or causal fraction
analysis.cohort_scope: Start-free and previous-end/current-start arrived intersection; no filtering using current endpoint; surface split uses current start layer normals only

motion_accounting.velocity_definition: geometry is last rollout dx/dt before commit; promoted_geometry includes all endpoint position corrections
motion_accounting.residual_definition: bond_residual includes k_update arithmetic roundoff; layer_residual includes relaxation and layer arithmetic roundoff
